text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.

- Portugal will be among 13 EU countries to join the first phase of Economic and Monetary Union in terms of meeting the budget deficit target, according to a draft of the European Commission's Autumn report made available to the paper. Only Greece and Italy will fail to meet the budget deficit targets, according to the report.
- The Portuguese government prepares Banco Nacional Ultramarino (BNU) for possible privatisation, Under-secretary for the Budget Manuela Arcanjo told the paper.
- Banco Comercial dos Acores is to open a new branch in the USA in early 1997.
- Caixa Geral de Depositos will take a majority stake in Banco Comercial e de Investimento de Mocambique, a source linked to the process told the paper.
- Bank of Portugal experts said disinflation in recent years helped the economy although it raised unemployment.

- Banco Espirito Santo (BES) holding's Espirito Santo Activos Financeiros (ESAF) has created a financial services group to operate mainly in South Africa. ESAF associated to Old Mutual, one of the biggest South African financial groups.
- Natural gas will arrive in Portugal from Algeria on December 15 and will start to be distributed in January, according to executives from gas distributor Transgas.
- Banco de Portugal governor Antonio de Sousa believes the government's 2.25-2.5 percent 1997 inflation objective will only be achieved with firm containment of salaries.
